description: Implementation of QuicNetworkBlackholeDetector class for detecting network blackholes in QUIC protocol, including alarm management and detection logic.

classes.name: AlarmDelegate
classes.description: Internal delegate class for handling alarm callbacks within QuicNetworkBlackholeDetector.

methods.name: QuicNetworkBlackholeDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the detector with delegate, arena, alarm factory, and context.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm firing, checks deadlines, and triggers detection callbacks.

methods.name: StopDetection
methods.description: Stops detection, optionally permanently, and resets deadlines.

methods.name: RestartDetection
methods.description: Restarts detection with new deadlines and verifies last deadline.

methods.name: GetEarliestDeadline
methods.description: Returns the earliest of the current deadlines.

methods.name: GetLastDeadline
methods.description: Returns the latest of the current deadlines.

methods.name: UpdateAlarm
methods.description: Updates the alarm to trigger at the earliest deadline.

methods.name: IsDetectionInProgress
methods.description: Checks if detection is currently active.
